snippet.title: Angry Birds 2 - Meet Melody, Musical Mayhem!
snippet.description:
Angry Birds 2 is ready to welcome Melody, the newest member of the flock!  🎶

Having grown up in a musical nest, Melody is slow to anger, but when she gets upset, she expresses herself through song - to devastating effect! 

When she starts singing at the top of her lungs, anything that isn't nailed down may get inhaled, only to be shot out like a bullet when she gets to the chorus... Prepare for true musical mayhem, piggies! 😱
